task: Trace the valid generic-typed-enum-match body from checker occurrences into the ABI-v10 checked-body path.
observation: The structured inspect query reported the exact enum TypeRef and open result scheme, but the body status was unsupported and its requirement count was zero. A temporary occurrence trace showed the checker had retained the case identities, payload binding, and open Int + T operation, while the operation result was initially recorded as Int and no operator requirement linked it to T. This meant inspect alone did not expose the missing checker-to-requirement edge; source/v9 execution confirmed the profile itself was valid.
impact: The initial implementation would have had to guess a return relationship or lose this accepted body. Inspect plus a focused occurrence trace isolated the missing relation before ABI projection work proceeded.

resolution.summary: The checker now retains Int + T -> T from the exact open operation operands, and common occurrence lowering projects Match cases with provider declaration, variant, payload, and return checks.
